description: This file defines the MediaTypeForm class, a Drupal form controller for managing media type entities, including form building, validation, submission, and related operations within the Drupal media module.

classes.name: MediaTypeForm
classes.description: Form controller class for managing media type entities within Drupal, handling form display, validation, submission, and related entity operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MediaTypeForm with plugin manager, entity field manager, and display repository services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: ajaxHandlerData
methods.description: AJAX callback to update form parts dynamically based on media source selection.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the media type form, including fields for name, ID, description, source plugin, field mapping, and settings.

methods.name: getWorkflowOptions
methods.description: Prepares default workflow options for publishing and revision settings.

methods.name: getSourceSubFormState
methods.description: Creates a subform state for configuring the media source plugin.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, including media source plugin configuration.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving media type entity, source plugin configuration, and updating related fields.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, including submit and delete buttons, with AJAX rebuild logic.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the media type entity, manages source field creation, display configuration, and status messages.
